title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20
lineage: 7in Master Reels at 7.5ips half-track > Panasonic SV-3700 DAT > Panasonic SV-3800 DAT > DAT > CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v1.01) > .shn encoding

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an energetic May‑1973 show with crisp guitar work and standout jams (China > Rider, The Other One, Playin'), despite occasional splice and mix quirks.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its high energy, tight improvisations and memorable moments like the China > Rider segue, a soaring Eyes/Other One marathon, and a fiery Playin' in the Band. The SBD source is generally clear and lets you hear each instrument, though listeners note occasional AUD splices, low bass, and uneven vocal balance that can distract.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers award 5‑star ratings and highlight exceptional playing; a few note recording mix issues, pulling the average down slightly but not enough to outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp SBD with clear instrument separation; occasional AUD splice patches and occasional low‑bass or vocal drop‑outs, plus some balancing problems in the Other One section.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A long, three‑set marathon that builds from a high‑octane first set into an especially explosive third set; the jam after Truckin' and the extended Other One are highlighted as peak moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is described as crisp, tight and potent; vocals sound ragged from a cold but he compensates with powerful leads.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work noted as solid and jazzy, especially during the Phil‑Bill swing sections in the jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides strong rhythm and engages in tight jams with Jerry and Phil, notably on Sunshine and the Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is praised for being “on his game” with clear, vibrant organ/piano parts throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy (Bill) is highlighted as booming and right up there, driving the energy of the set.
